newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.14 rupees down at 42.67 to the dollar on Tuesday in the kerb market amid a rise in dollar demand, dealers said.
They said the rupee might fall further as investors who had been pumping dollars into the market began holding onto them, taking their cue from dwindling supplies from abroad.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 6.50 percent, compared to Monday's close at 6.30 percent.
